bio: What could be better suited to this time-honoured setting than classic Czech cuisine? The lavish restaurant of the venerable Grand Hotel Pupp is housed in a magnificent space boasting high ceilings, an abundance of mouldings and stylish details such as fine chandeliers and mirrors, elegant fabrics and heavy curtains, all exuding a sense of history. An adept front-of-house team serves classically rooted cuisine with Czech and international influences. Both a set menu and à la carte options are available....
